purpose: Selection rule for Root's later Current-frontier refresh after the completed authority-folder move. This file neither writes nor approves Current sources or projections.

folder_mapping.rule: longest old_authority prefix maps to its new_authority

named_selection.proposed: Current Methodology and direct Project RMED after Scope Unit authority migration
named_selection.why: The old selection text does not distinguish an authority path moved by the longest-prefix map from an installed 000 fallback. The refreshed frontier must state that sources are selected from their mapped authority owners and exclude installed 000 copies.

inclusion_rule: Start with every Current R/M/E/D member of the prior selected authority scope, resolving its new physical path by the longest old_authority to new_authority mapping.
Retain a source only when the resolved mapped path exists, its Current metadata is Active, and its base ID/version/SHA-256 are captured at final readback.

Include a shared-model replacement only when its retired/replaced predecessor was selected and its replacement manifest names that replacement; preserve the predecessor-to-replacement reason in the refreshed receipt.

Include a native Scope Unit Declaration among the 44 only when its declared Scope Unit is an original selected authority owner or a selected owner ancestor required to address that source. Do not include declarations merely because they are shared model material or physically adjacent.
Include direct PROJECT_CONFIGURATION RMED under the same original direct-project scope rule.
exclusion_rule: Exclude retired IDs, including CA-D-297 per the peer retirement/replacement receipt; do not recover it from Git or an archive.
Exclude installed 000 copies, archives, drafts, projections, runtime/fixture files, and a new carrier-destination design decision.
Exclude a replacement that lacks a selected predecessor/owner justification, even if it is listed in a shared model cutover manifest.

manifest_observations.decision: These are candidates for the ownership test, not automatic additions. CA-D-297 is explicitly excluded.

final_capture_gate: Recompute every resolved path, SHA-256, version, status, and content-role from physically present Current sources only.
Record exact inclusion/exclusion reason and predecessor/replacement linkage for every changed selected member.
Reject duplicate base IDs, a missing selected owner, any archive/draft/000 source, or a missing mapped path.
Only after a root-owned Current-frontier receipt may the projection staging runner use the refreshed frontier.
